tool_input.command:
cat >> db/schema.ts <<'EOF'

export const comments = sqliteTable('comments', {
  id: integer('id').primaryKey({ autoIncrement: true }),
  postId: integer('post_id')
    .notNull()
    .references(() => posts.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  userId: integer('user_id')
    .notNull()
    .references(() => users.id),
  body: text('body').notNull(),
  createdAt: text('created_at').notNull().$defaultFn(() => new Date().toISOString()),
})

export const commentReports = sqliteTable(
  'comment_reports',
  {
    id: integer('id').primaryKey({ autoIncrement: true }),
    commentId: integer('comment_id')
      .notNull()
      .references(() => comments.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
    userId: integer('user_id')
      .notNull()
      .references(() => users.id),
    createdAt: text('created_at').notNull().$defaultFn(() => new Date().toISOString()),
  },
  (table) => [unique('comment_reports_comment_user_unique').on(table.commentId, table.userId)],
)
EOF
sed -i '' "1s/.*/import { sqliteTable, integer, text, unique } from '@guren\/orm\/drizzle\/sqlite'/" db/schema.ts
bunx guren make:migration comments 2>&1 | tail -5; ls db/migrations; cat app/Models/User.ts | head -20

result:
Comments, reporting and auto-hiding are in. `bunx guren gate` passes (codegen, typecheck, lint, check, audit, tests), including my new tests.

- **Storage:** `db/schema.ts` gains `comments` and `comment_reports`. The reports table has a unique (`comment_id`, `user_id`) pair and both tables cascade on delete. The migration is `db/migrations/20260925021958_comments`.
- **Endpoints:** `routes/web.ts` adds `POST /posts/:id/comments`, `DELETE /comments/:id` and `POST /comments/:id/report`, all behind the `auth` middleware, so a guest is redirected to `/login`.
- **Controller:** `CommentController` enforces the rules.
  - Create validates the body at 1–2000 characters through the route schema, so a bad body gets the same 422 as a bad post title.
  - Delete allows only the comment's author or the post's author and answers 403 to anyone else.
  - Report always answers 204 and a repeat report by the same user stays one row.
- **Post page:** `PostController.show` now passes `comments`, oldest first, in the `{ id, body, author: { id, name }, createdAt }` shape. It leaves out any comment with three or more distinct reporters. Those comments stay in `comments`.
- **Post delete:** `PostController.destroy` removes the post's comments and their reports explicitly, because SQLite only honours `ON DELETE CASCADE` when foreign keys are switched on, and I didn't confirm they are here.
- **UI:** `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx` lists the comments, adds a comment box for signed-in users, and shows Delete where the viewer may use it plus Report.
- **Tests:** `tests/CommentController.test.ts` covers the guest redirect, validation, permissions, the 204 on a repeat report, hiding after three reporters, and deleting a post.

I didn't check the page in a browser, only through the tests. The regenerated `.guren/*.gen.ts` files are in the diff too.
